Sanitizer ignores inherited and unsafe keys, never invokes getters, and returns fresh state
Five complete frozen built-in looks include exact Original and distinct coherent balances
Initialization and reads never write, and snapshots cannot mutate stored values
Each field patches the latest state, clamps, and preserves all other fields and custom looks
Replace resets unspecified settings deliberately and preserves latest saved looks
Preset save normalizes names, upserts case-insensitively, preserves current appearance, and rejects invalid input
20-look limit permits updates and atomic import rejects overflow without partial changes
Export/import roundtrip retains IDs, names and exact settings; reimport has no duplicates
Import validates bytes, format/version, count, names, settings, IDs and prototype keys atomically
Import resolves colliding safe IDs and retains target IDs for name updates
Delete reads latest state, preserves other settings/looks, and rejects missing or unsafe IDs
Corrupt persisted state recovers bounded safe snapshots without writing
False, thrown and truthy non-boolean writes never report persistence; transient candidate remains available
Unreadable storage never receives a partial write and exposes an honest temporary candidate
